The rung is already resolved per payload and off already means enable_thinking False — the model's non-thinking mode — so the thinking/non-thinking discriminator exists; effort.py's pinned import direction (config imports effort, never the reverse) constrains where a rung-keyed table may live.

scope_entries.surface: colleague/config_defaults.py + config_resolve.py::_scalar_knobs + config.py:348 + config_snapshot.py + cli/_commands/config.py + explain/catalog_ops.py
scope_entries.finding: _DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE = 0.0 is the greedy default; COLLEAGUE_TEMPERATURE is resolved in the scalar block with a CONVERTIBLE_ alias, and every scalar knob is mirrored in the dataclass field, the snapshot, config show and the explain catalog — five surfaces per new knob.

Records that only qwen-code's two always-on guards were ported and that the content/thought-repetition tier was deliberately NOT ported (off upstream for false positives, spec c17/c20); check() is tool-call-only and cannot see reasoning text.

Reasoning arrives as incremental deltas on the streaming path (reasoning/reasoning_content both honoured), so an in-turn detector has input there and only there; the existing idle/lifetime stream guards were observed NOT firing on a 25-minute silent stream, a separate defect.

The acting seat already records a truncated-turn warning carrying finish_reason and reasoning_chars plus a live phase notice — the exact line the issue quotes as evidence — so fix (3) is mostly landed; only the named reason text and the non-empty-content case remain.
Posts temperature: 0 hard-coded in the same body that may carry an armed thinking rung via distilleffort.chat_template_fragment — a second greedy-in-thinking-mode site outside the adapter.
A checked-in per-file baseline that only tightens plus a hard 1000-line ceiling; growing config.py or vllm_openai.py fails CI, which is why every recent increment shipped as a new leaf module.

The vLLM-adapter convention enumerates exactly three graceful-degrade carve-outs and thinking-effort.md's 'The wire' names chat_template_kwargs as the only per-seat body key; per-model configuration is an exact-path hooks/AGENTS overlay with no value table, so model-keyed sampling values are a new keying concept.
Row 66 is the greedy-low evidence; the operator's three comments supersede the issue body (1.0 not 0.6, two profiles not one, penalties deferred) and void the first temp-1.0 arm as a rig failure.
Two diagnostic probes hard-code temperature 0.0 deliberately (determinism, not reasoning), and two fixture tests already pin exact request bodies — the offline proof surface for a payload change.

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / adjacent-systems lens: colleague/profiles.py ModeProfile
scope_entries.finding: Clean. ModeProfile carries max_steps, context_budget_fraction, synthesis_reserve_steps, timeout and fillline_threshold — no temperature or sampling field — so apply_mode_profile cannot collide with the new profile's precedence. Examined, nothing found.

Clean. The realtime lane is the ears-only WebSocket client; its session.update handshake carries turn detection and PCM16 audio format, never sampling parameters, and it never calls response.create. Out of the profile's reach by construction.

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / adjacent-systems lens: the full set of payload builders
scope_entries.finding: Enumerated: the adapter's _build_chat_payload (its associate branch already separate), distill.py::_openai_completion, and the two oilcheck probes. No other module in colleague/ constructs a messages payload, so the profile's reach is a closed set of four call sites.

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / lifecycle lens: work --continue and tests/test_continue_effort_reapply.py
scope_entries.finding: A continued run re-applies the rung recorded on the prior artifact and warns loudly when it differs from what env/config would now resolve. Sampling derives from that rung plus the model id, so it follows automatically — but only if the profile is recorded, which is why the artifact-recording requirement matters for continuation and not only for diagnosis.

scope_entries.finding: Fan-out above width 1 runs children concurrently in one process, so any detector state must be turn-scoped; the sampling profile itself is immutable per-payload and is not a hazard.

scope_entries.finding: Two probes. Extension keys accepted and honoured (top_k 1 at temperature 2.0 gives three identical completions; without top_k, three different ones). An invented key also returns 200, so unknown keys are silently ignored and a status code proves nothing about application.

scope_entries.finding: Clean and not applicable respectively: sampling parameters carry no credential or user data and widen no trust boundary, and no persisted state or schema changes, so there is nothing to migrate and no downgrade path to design. Examined, nothing found.

scope_entries.finding: Partially examined only. The incident evidence shows killing the client dropped the origin GPU to 0 percent instantly, which suggests closing the connection does stop generation, but this pass did NOT probe an abort directly and the guard's cut depends on it. Residual risk parked rather than claimed.

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / dependency lens: tests/test_zero_deps.py + the PyYAML-forbidden docstrings
scope_entries.finding: YAML is unavailable without breaching the single-base-dependency convention: four modules state PyYAML is forbidden and the guard allow-lists exactly agentfront. JSON is the only stdlib option, which settles the file format by constraint rather than preference.

The repo-level config file already resolves repo-over-user with a machine-wide per-key merge and is already rendered by config show, so a sampling section inherits all of it; a dedicated file would have needed a second discovery path and a second merge story.

The second discovery path s23 counted as a cost is what buys a tracked, shareable, secret-free table — .colleague/models.json, allow-listed beside commands/ and skills/.
